skill.description: Set up GitHub authentication using HTTPS tokens, SSH keys, or gh CLI login without exposing credentials.

memory.responsibility: Retain github account plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform https token or ssh choice into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through credential helper or keychain while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose the minimum service operations required for the requested target; writes require an explicit preview gate.

stages: Choose HTTPS token SSH or browser login
Store through an approved credential helper

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
